skill.summary: Tracks your business's Google Maps ranking, local pack visibility, competitor positions, and provides actionable tips to improve local SEO performance.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Local SEO Rank Checker.

- Track Google Maps ranking positions for local businesses in real-time.
- Monitor local pack visibility, competitor rankings, and changes over time.
- Analyze key ranking factors including reviews, citations, and website optimization.
- Get actionable improvement tips and dynamic keyword performance reports.
- Features daily monitoring, weekly competitor analysis, and monthly strategy recommendations.
